page0.text:
...
...I open my eyes.
I stick my arm up in the air for no real reason, stare at the ceiling, then let it fall on the futon.

page1.text:
"Feels kinda...heavy."
I keep gazing absently at the ceiling without getting up.
It feels like my whole body is slow.
My head is in a daze and my body wants rest.
That must be why I don't feel like getting up, even though it's already morning.

page2.text:
"Mm... Why am I so tired?"
Maybe the fatigue has been building up.
A lot happened yesterday, but I didn't go to bed particularly exhausted.
I probably feel this way because I didn't sleep enough.

page8.text:
"...Maybe I didn't sleep well. Eh, the blood will start flowing once I move around."
Sakura's in much worse shape than I am, anyway.
She's doing her best, so I can't let a little grogginess keep me down.

page9.text:
I pump myself up for the day and get out of bed.
"Urgh..."
Then, the dizziness hits me again.
It isn't from my body's slowness.
It's like...as soon as I look at my bedroom door, I remember what happened last night all too vividly.

page10.text:
"Um... I'd better change."
...Oh, man.
If this is already making me blush, how am I going to talk to Sakura today?

page12.text:
...
I'll be okay. I've already run this simulation a bunch of times.
There's nothing difficult about it. It's just a "good morning" like always. What am I getting so worked up for?

page14.text:
"Ah."
But...
I thought Sakura would be in the kitchen, but she's already putting breakfast on the table.

page15.text:
"Ah... G-good morning, Senpai."
"Uh. Yeah. Mor...ning. Sakura."

page16.text:
"Um...uh."
"Uhhh... well."
I try to think of something clever to say, but draw a blank.

page18.text:
"M-morning, Sakura! Breakfast looks really good!"
How unimaginative, even for me.
...Wait, I greeted her already! Idiot!

page19.text:
"Uh, yes! G-good morning, Senpai!"
...
But...
Somehow, Sakura's reply feels exactly the same, too.

page20.text:
Her eyes go wide, as if she's realized the same thing.
I must be making the same face.

page21.text:
"Hah..."
The thought makes me relax.
We've both been nervously looking forward to seeing each other.

page22.text:
"Whew. Good morning for the third time, Sakura."
I feel myself smiling.
This time, I say it with relief.
"...Yes. Good morning, Senpai."

page23.text: Then, we awkwardly start eating breakfast.

page24.text:
"Let's eat, then."
"Yes, let's eat."
Even though we try to carry on like we always do, I still can't stop feeling nervous.

page25.text:
...
I move my chopsticks uneasily.
Sakura eats cheerfully, like she's gotten used to it already.
...Is this something that girls are better at?

page26.text:
"Hm? What's wrong? Oh, would you like more miso soup?"
"...No, I'm still on my first bowl. But it's good. Delicious, actually."
"Yes, I'm confident in today's breakfast. I'm glad you like it."
